texts.facts: Thereafter, the case was continuously adjourned at the stage of prosecution evidence.
texts.arguments: 3. Learned counsel for the petitioner contended that without adding the manufacturer as a party, the case against the present petitioner is not maintainable. He further alleged that, after repeal of the earlier Act viz Preservation of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 the petitioner cannot be prosecuted for the offence in this regard. 4. Learned Panel Lawyer for the respondent/State has strongly opposed the aforesaid contention of the petitioner. 5. In this regard, it is important to mention here that the charge under Section 59 of the Food Safety Vijay Gugnani vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 9 September, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/110256708/ 1 and Standards Act, 2006 has been framed against the petitioner on 11.11.2011. 8. Further that Section 89 of the 2006 Act prescribes as under:- "89. Overriding effect of this Act over all other food related laws- The provisions of this Act shall have effect notwithstanding anything inconsistent therewith contained in any other law for the time being in force or in any instrument having effect by virtue of any law other than this Act." 9. 10. [M.Cr.C. No.1301/2011 decided on 20.02.2017] and Sharad Kumar Sanghi Vs. Sangita Rane, (2015) 12 SCC 781.
